blocks.x: Document and scene understanding wired into the systems of record: extraction with per-field confidence, ledger reconciliation that catches what models miss, and evidence trails that let auditors verify every posted value without leaving the console.
Vision in the enterprise is a bookkeeping problem wearing a camera

Vision in the enterprise is document understanding first, scene understanding second: extraction that feeds a system of record, QA that catches what humans miss, and safety monitoring that has to work at 2am without a person watching.

The engineering center of gravity is the handshake between perception and process. A great detector that cannot write to the workflow, reconcile against the ledger and explain its confidence to an auditor is a demo. We build the reconciliation and explanation layers with the same seriousness as the models.

The sections below cover the failure modes that erode trust in extraction, the reference architecture that keeps humans in the loop where it matters, and the gates that decide what posts straight through.
Four failure modes that turn extraction into re-work
Every one of these shows up as a review backlog rather than an error report — which is why the countermeasures target the review queue, not just the model.

blocks.x: Reference architecture — confidence-gated extraction into systems of record

The architecture's central decision is the confidence gate: fields above threshold post straight through, fields below route to a review surface that trains the loop. Reconciliation runs on the ledger side, so misposting is caught where the money lives.

blocks.note: Confidence gating is the honest heart of the system: below-bar fields go to humans with the evidence attached, and the threshold is tuned per field class, not globally.

widgets.title: From pixels to grounded decision — click each stage

stages.name: Capture
stages.detail: Cameras and scanners expose calibration state, lighting conditions and frame rate; a sensor that drifts flags itself before its data poisons the eval.

stages.name: Preprocess
stages.detail: Resolution normalization, lens correction and class-specific augmentation — the same transforms recorded for training so inference never drifts from training assumptions.

stages.name: Detect
stages.detail: Specialized detectors per task class (defects, presence, geometry) run at the edge; uncertain frames escalate with crops attached rather than guessing centrally.

stages.name: Reason
stages.detail: The VLM reasons over crops and metadata for the tasks that need language: scene QA, incident summaries, doc understanding — always grounded to the regions it was given.

stages.name: Act & audit
stages.detail: Decisions carry their evidence: crops, OCR strings, model versions, confidence — the artifact a quality audit or incident review reads first.

widgets.note: Edge detects, central reasons, everything grounds — the split is an economics decision the panel above makes explicit.

blocks.x: Extraction stack defaults — and documented deviations
Defaults bias toward per-field evidence and reconciliation over raw model scores; deviations are permitted where document classes argue for them, with the trigger conditions written alongside.

blocks.caption: Multimodal AI & Vision-Language Systems: default stack and the conditions under which we deviate
rows: Detection
Layout detectors (DiT/RT-DETR class) fine-tuned on your templates
Generic off-the-shelf detection only for cold-start, always retrained
OCR
Ensemble: classic engine + VLM OCR for degraded captures
Single engine only when capture quality is controlled end to end
Reasoning
VLM for complex tables, stamps and cross-page logic
Deterministic extractors wherever a rule beats a model — cheaper and auditable
Reconciliation
Typed matching against ledger with tolerance bands
Free-text matching — it hides errors the ledger will not
Serving
Batch for archive backlogs; streaming API for live capture
One path for both — the batch is 90% of volume and needs its own cost curve
Evidence
Crop + rationale + confidence per field, immutable store
End-result-only logging — fails the first serious audit
